name: redirect-to-example
description: Always redirect incoming requests to https://example.com

scripts.build: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -i build/bundle.js --initLocation http://redirect-to-example.localhost -o dist/redirect-to-example.wasm
scripts.build:debug: node build.mjs && mkdirp dist && j2w -d -i build/bundle.js --initLocation http://redirect-to-example.localhost -o dist/redirect-to-example.wasm
